extDescription.message: Opens the tab you choose (Videos, Live, Playlists...) when you visit a YouTube channel. One preference per channel.

popupNotChannel.message: Open a YouTube channel to choose which tab it opens on.

popupError.message: Could not read this channel. Reload the YouTube tab and try again.

popupHowItWorks.message: Each channel remembers its own tab. If the chosen tab does not exist, Videos opens instead.
